ci: github actions workflow and xtask checks

Adds continuous integration and local checks:

- .github/workflows/ci.yml, on pull requests and pushes to main:
  - lint: cargo fmt, REUSE (the fsfe/reuse image pinned by digest) and
    cargo-deny;
  - test, on Linux: Clippy with warnings denied for Linux and, from Linux,
    the Windows and macOS targets; nextest with no retries; doc-tests under
    a deadline;
  - ci-ok, the single check a ruleset can require.
  Hardening: one action (actions/checkout, pinned to a commit SHA, without
  persisted credentials), no other action, permissions {} with read-only
  jobs, no untrusted text in scripts, and tools downloaded at pinned
  versions and verified by SHA-256 before use.
- crates/xtask, with no dependencies: cargo xtask check runs the same
  checks locally across the workspace; cargo xtask hooks install adds an
  opt-in pre-push hook, never replaces a hook it did not write unless
  --force is given, and then keeps a backup.
- The README, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, LICENSING.md, ADR 0001 and the
  coding standards describe the checks that now exist. Tests run on Linux
  only until the first OS-specific code (coding standards rule 15).

Reviewed by GLM in three rounds, all passed; the five minor findings were
fixed (docs/reviews/2026-11-19-ci-and-xtask.md). A deliberately broken pull
request (#9) failed in fmt, Clippy and ci-ok, as it should.

Closes #1
